info.title: Publisher local authoring runtime
info.description: Actual local operation inventory. Responses not explicitly modeled remain partial schemas; no full OpenAPI conformance or whole-platform completion claim. Deltas from representative docs contract are CF-001/002. Interface locale support: 15 catalogs, Accept-Language, nullable legacy user locale and authenticated preference mutation; SQLite schema version 2.

messageKey.description: Language-neutral system catalog key for client retranslation; never authored manuscript text.

messageParams.description: Language-neutral interpolation values, optional for generic internal failures.

Locale.description: Interface language only; manuscript language/direction are independent. Region aliases negotiate on Accept-Language; saved preferences use canonical codes.

LocaleInput.description: Supported canonical code or regional alias, case-insensitive with hyphen/underscore separators; normalized to a supported base code. An unsupported base returns422. Output is always canonical. See Locale enum for supported bases.

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: Must equal configured loopback application origin or approved local Vite origin.

parameters.name: Accept-Language
parameters.description: Supported locale by weighted language ranges/region aliases. Unsupported values fall back to English; authenticated saved locale is used when the header is absent. Does not translate authored content.
